notes: Original v12 art is preserved. Standard portrait fits use nearest-neighbour; Legendary portraits remain at native size.
Artwork is a fitted bitmap; frame paths and type remain editable in each native VectorCraft master.
Final PNGs composite exact fitted pixels with the native transparent vector/type overlay.
Six Nearchus/Eumenes assets use editorial Epic styling; gameplay rarity remains unspecified.
ART PREVIEW and intended edition limits do not assign an issued copy.
